mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings from 2024 production as out of spec, with too little free spread so the thrust bearing slips onto the cap and block groove and risks spinning. Snippet states a King technical representative advised returning them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.
